verdicts.reason: A reads well left to right (logo, shoe, headline, subcopy, badge), but the lime circle is pulled away from the shoe and sits as a cropped blob at the right edge with the NEW VIDEO badge on it, so the original's shoe-on-circle motif is lost and the shoe is small. B leaves a large empty area on the left, moves the logo to the far right where it crowds the detached, cropped circle, drops the shoe against the bottom edge so its sole is cut off, and makes the subcopy and badge too small to read, with the badge jammed beside the subcopy.
